ModMetaData.name: FixWorld
ModMetaData.author: SmolBlackHole
ModMetaData.description:
FixWorld is an experimental performance and runtime optimization mod for RimWorld.
Its goal is to improve performance without changing gameplay behavior. FixWorld replaces or restructures selected internal systems where measurable improvements are possible, while keeping compatibility and correctness as primary constraints.
Current areas of work include: - Faster mod and content loading - Staged and parallelized initialization - Persistent texture caching - Reduced startup overhead - Improved loading diagnostics and progress reporting - Behavior-preserving runtime optimizations
Future work may extend into map generation, pathfinding, simulation hot paths, caching, scheduling, and other performance-critical systems.
FixWorld does not aim to alter game balance or mechanics. Optimizations are introduced only where they can be measured, validated, and kept functionally equivalent to vanilla behavior.
This project is under active development and may make deep changes to RimWorld's internal execution paths.
